notes: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Coder (GSQ-RCO Coder IQ2_XXS GGUF) on the Ferrite DeepSeek engine (--engine dsc), three RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 24 GB (one main card, two expert cards), one request at a time; DSML tool-call format (<｜DSML｜ calls> / invoke / parameter), reasoning in reasoning_content; the template thinks unless the request turns thinking off. The server closes a reasoning block at 8192 tokens, has a loop breaker (exact cycles and repeated sentences), never returns a stop token first, enforces tool_choice required / named by starting the reply inside the calls block, and applies the per-mode sampling below to the fields a client omits (reported in the x-sampling-effective response header); a client that sends temperature 0 gets greedy decoding with no penalty (greedy_keeps_fast_path).
